jobs.details: Urgently Hiring For: English + French Pulaar. Job Title: Freelance Remote Interpreter (English + French / Pulaar) Location: 100% Remote | Type: Freelance/Independent Contractor | Schedule: Flexible Job Summary We are seeking fluent multilingual speakers to provide Over-the-Phone (OPI) and Video Remote Interpretation (VRI). No prior experience is required—we provide full training. If you have strong language skills and a professional attitude, join us to bridge critical communication gaps in moments that matter. Key Responsibilities Provide accurate, real-time consecutive interpretation (English+Pulaar and French+Pulaar). Facilitate clear communication in high-stakes settings (e.g., healthcare, legal). Maintain strict confidentiality, neutrality, and professionalism. Manage your own schedule and log in reliably to handle calls. Qualifications & Tech Requirements Language: Native or near-native fluency in English, French, and Pulaar. Skills: Strong active listening, cultural sensitivity, and emotional resilience. Experience: Beginners welcome; prior interpreting experience is a plus. Workspace: A quiet, distraction-free home environment. Tech Setup: Dedicated computer, high-speed internet (wired preferred for VRI), and a noise-canceling USB headset. What We Offer Ultimate Flexibility: 100% remote work. Choose your own hours (daytime, evening, overnight). Steady Income: Competitive per-minute rates backed by reliable call volume. Growth: Free comprehensive onboarding and ongoing professional training. Referral Program: Refer qualified speakers of our in-demand languages and earn a bonus when your referral is successfully onboarded. To Apply: Ready to begin? Please submit your updated resume highlighting your language proficiency.

Joining is not a job offer. **Reports to:** Social Media Manager. **Contract:** Consultancy contract per campaign. ## **Why this roster** New Pathways to Resilience (NPR) is a three-year project funded by the EU’s Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund (AMIF). It is built around Seefar’s Crisis Adaptation Mechanism (CAM), which lets the project respond when migration patterns shift. When a monitored indicator crosses its threshold, a campaign may be activated for a new audience or language, and Seefar then has two weeks to launch it. That is too short to recruit from scratch, so we keep an unpaid standby pool of vetted Counsellors, Social Media Officers and Monitoring Officers for 12 languages, ready to be contracted the moment a campaign is approved. ## **Who we are** Seefar Foundation is a social enterprise with a simple mission: to transform the lives of vulnerable people. Through programmes rooted in technology, psychology and behaviour change, we help people build the skills and confidence they need to make a positive contribution to their communities. It’s how we support governments in finding solutions to challenges around irregular migration, poverty, human trafficking, violent extremism, access to justice, and more.
